home.title: The receptionist that never sleeps
home.subtitle: Answers your customers' messages instantly, in Czech and English, using only your own information. When it isn't sure, it hands over to you.

points.instant: Replies within seconds, day and night
points.honest: Never makes things up: answers only from your info
points.control: You see every conversation and can step in any time

auth.emailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed. Please log in.

auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a reset link.

onboarding.title: Set up your receptionist
onboarding.changeLater: You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.doneBody: Your receptionist will only know what you filled in. The more FAQs you add, the more questions it can answer on its own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only the owner of the business can change these settings.

widget.title: Chat widget for your website
widget.intro: Add the chat bubble to your website, so your receptionist can answer customers there.
widget.offHint: While it's off, the chat bubble shows that the chat is unavailable.
widget.snippetHint: Paste it into your website, just before the closing '</body>' tag. On Wix, WordPress or Webflow use "custom code" / "footer code" in the site settings. If someone else manages your website, send them this code.
widget.tryHint: Ask what your customers usually ask. Test conversations are marked so they don't count in your statistics.
widget.staffOnly: Only the owner can set up the chat widget.
widget.notReady: Finish the basics of your business profile first.

dashboard.finishSetupBody: A few steps are left before your receptionist knows enough to help.

chat.inboxSoon: You'll be able to read and answer them in the inbox (coming in the next milestone).

basics.title: About your business
basics.intro: The basics your receptionist needs to introduce your business.
basics.name: Business name
basics.languages: Languages you talk to customers in
basics.languagesHint: Your receptionist replies in the language the customer writes in.
basics.descriptionHint: What you do, what makes you special, where to find you. A few sentences is enough.
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A cosy specialty coffee café in Vinohrady with homemade cakes and a quiet back room for laptop work.
basics.typePlaceholder: e.g. Tattoo studio, Café and bakery
basics.mainLanguageHint: The language you'll write your services and FAQs in.
basics.typeHint: Describe in your own words what you do.
basics.websiteHint: We can fill in your type of business, description and contact details from your website. You'll review everything.
basics.imported: Done! Please review what we filled in and adjust it if needed.
basics.importedContacts: We also found contact details on your website. We'll save them and you'll review them in the next step.

importErrors.invalid_url: Please enter a valid website address, e.g. mybusiness.com.
importErrors.fetch_failed: We couldn't load the website. Check the address, or fill in the details yourself.
importErrors.nothing_found: We didn't find enough information on the website. Please fill in the details yourself.
importErrors.ai_unavailable: Filling in from the website isn't working right now. Please fill in the details yourself.

contact.title: Contact & booking
contact.intro: Where customers can find you and how they book.
contact.bookingUrlHint: Your receptionist shares this link when someone wants to book (Reservio, Fresha, your own page, …).

services.title: Services & prices
services.intro: List what you offer. Your receptionist will never guess a price: if a price isn't here, it says it will check with you.
services.suggestions: Common for your type of business: tap to add
services.empty: No services yet. Add your first one.
services.name: Name
services.priceHint: Leave "to" empty for a fixed price. Leave both empty if the price is on request.
services.priceNotePlaceholder: e.g. depends on size, deposit 1,000 CZK

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.intro: When you are open. Your receptionist uses this to answer "are you open now?"
hours.overnightHint: If the end time is earlier than the start, it means after midnight.
hours.exceptionsIntro: Days when you are closed or open at different times.
hours.overlap: Time ranges on the same day must not overlap.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: The questions customers ask you most, with your answers. This is what your receptionist uses most often.
faqs.suggestions: Questions customers often ask businesses like yours: tap to add, then write your answer
faqs.question: Question

assistant.title: Tone & rules
assistant.intro: How your receptionist should sound, and what it must never answer on its own.

tones.friendlyExample: Hi there! 😊 On Saturday we're open from 9 am to 2 pm. Looking forward to seeing you!
tones.professionalExample: Hello, on Saturday we are open from 9:00 to 14:00.
tones.casualExample: Hey! Sure, we're here Saturday 9 to 2 🙌

assistant.toneNotes: Anything else about how you talk?
assistant.toneNotesPlaceholder: e.g. We're on first-name terms with customers. Sign off as "The Café Team".
assistant.neverAnswerTitle: Never answer: always hand over to me
assistant.neverAnswerIntro: Topics your receptionist must not handle. It will politely say it will check with the team and notify you.
assistant.instructionsIntro: Anything else your receptionist should always keep in mind.
assistant.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Always mention we only accept card payments.
assistant.toneExampleQuestion: Example – a customer asks: "Are you open on Saturday?"
assistant.toneChangeLater: You can change the tone any time later in Settings.
